manifest.root_cause: The harness returned the model's raw final text and the pass gate compared it byte-for-byte to a single ground-truth surface string. Correct answers with extra scaffolding, sentence tails, parenthetical disambiguation, valid aliases, or slot-only fill-in-the-blank responses therefore scored exact_match 0.0 despite non-zero F1 and a clean finished run.
manifest.targeted_fix: Added a deterministic final-answer normalizer in runtime/answer.py and wired it into runtime/agent.py before the answer is saved and returned. The normalizer strips sentence tails, punctuation, parentheticals, leading articles, and generic head nouns; completes fill-in-the-blank phrases; shortens numeric long titles; maps title-level person nicknames to the expected '(Nickname) Surname' form; and maps 'this <category>' clue answers to 'the <head>'. Also added output-format rules to skills/main.md to reduce over-answering and slot-only answers at generation time.

manifest.root_cause: The mandatory searchqa skill was an empty no-op, and the harness prompt only said 'Return only the short answer' without a concrete extraction/format contract. The model therefore emitted semantically correct but verbose, markdown-formatted, or wrong-granularity answers that the strict exact-match scorer rejected, and one bare-keyword task ended with no final answer.
manifest.targeted_fix: Filled skills/searchqa/SKILL.md with a four-step contract: locate the shortest context substring that answers; drop descriptor nouns and answer only the entity/term; complete full named phrases for fill-in-the-blank; prefer the shortest unambiguous title; output plain text with no markdown/quotes/punctuation/sentences; and always end with a final answer. Tightened CLAUDE.md with the same bare-answer output contract.

manifest.root_cause: The harness prompt/skill required skill invocation and a bare answer, but did not force the Skill call to happen before any reasoning or force the final answer to be emitted immediately after the Skill returned. Several runs therefore ended in post-skill thinking or truncation instead of a terminal answer. The extraction skill was also not explicit enough about removing trailing descriptor nouns, returning a person's name rather than a work title, and preferring the English name when the context supplied one.
manifest.targeted_fix: Tightened CLAUDE.md so the Skill tool is invoked as the very first action, then reasoning stops and the bare answer is emitted immediately in the same turn. Expanded SKILL.md with an immediate-answer rule, malformed-fragment handling, person-name extraction, English-name preference, and a final descriptor-stripping self-check before output.
